observations.humor_and_voices: Neet treats a physically unmanageable ball as a prestigious possession; Buddy first demonstrates his convenient ordinary ball, then wants a turn with the supposedly excessive one. The mouth-as-handle exchange, wrong-moon rejection, mop teamwork that reverses the cleaning, and Buddy saying I was checking after his own failed bite provide different comic mechanisms. Sagar participates through the rolling-colleague line and calm intervention; Heather has both amused warmth and the exasperated mop payoff. Approved is a recurring Neet motif with changed function at his restrained acceptance of Buddy, rather than every character sharing a voice.
observations.cause_effect_and_timing: Oversize failed grip explains chest-herding and assistance. Possession precedes window distress and guarding; the nap collision creates a consequence, followed by apology and repeated practice. The week montage varies scale and gives the sharing reversal a prepared setup. Images follow completed dialogue beats and allow the next response to land afterward.
observations.payoff: Buddy experiences the same failed bite he mocked, but Neet permits his turn. The revisited curb shows Neet can be content without carrying the ball; the basket ritual and Buddy waiting for a turn close the emotional arc while Tomorrow I am bringing mine retains his independent preference. Warm ending is not crowded by an additional image.

image_placement.observation: After eating-the-moon joke and before second try: oversized grounded ball outside Neet mouth, night sidewalk, attached leashes, flashlight and amused Buddy match the paused failed-grip state. Smooth replacement body coats read clearly at intended size.

Immediately after Wrong moon: closed glass still separates the outdoor cool ball from Neet; ordinary offered ball is rejected on the indoor floor and Buddy remains on rug. Door has not opened, so rescue is not prematurely shown.

After Buddy failed bite and I was checking, before Approved and return nudge: Buddy head remains lowered toward grounded oversize ball; Neet watches without intervention, empty basket nearby. The image holds the comic reversal before the conciliatory response.
